Hi! Great plan to finish your Open Water certification with a refresher first — that will help you feel confident and safe before the referral dives.

The 2-day Open Water Referral Course from Cartagena includes 4 certification dives with an instructor, boat transport, lunch on day 1, equipment, dive insurance, and the national park fee.
